verdicts.title: Topological Entropy for Arbitrary Subsets of Infinite Product Spaces
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: In this note a notion of generalized topological entropy for arbitrary subsets of the space of all sequences in a compact topological space is introduced. It is shown that for a continuous map on a compact space the generalized topological entropy of the set of all orbits of the map coincides with the classical topological entropy of the map. verdicts.title: On estimating the entropy of shallow circuit outputs
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Estimating the entropy of probability distributions and quantum states is a fundamental task in information processing. Here, we examine the hardness of this task for the case of probability distributions or quantum states produced by shallow circuits.
